name: Share QR
description: A downloadable, build-time site QR card with an accessible dialog.
author: Paolo Gabriel

settings.name: Target URL
settings.description: Absolute HTTP(S) URL. Empty uses validated meta.siteBaseUrl. Credentials and malformed URLs are rejected.

settings.name: Card label
settings.description: Plain text heading, up to 500 characters. HTML is escaped.

settings.name: Download filename
settings.description: Filename stem, sanitized to letters, digits, hyphens and underscores, at most 80 characters.

settings.name: Offer SVG
settings.description: Use SVG for the image and fallback link when enabled. At least one format remains enabled.

settings.name: Offer PNG
settings.description: Prefer PNG for Download QR. Both assets are generated from the same target; this controls availability in the card.

settings.name: Trigger label
settings.description: Optional short visible text beside the trigger glyph (plain text, up to 500 characters). Leave empty for an icon-only button; the accessible name is then the card label.

settings.name: Trigger icon
settings.description: Built-in inline SVG mark: qr, link, or none. No icon font, HTML, or remote assets.

settings.name: Maximum QR display size
settings.description: Pixels, clamped to 160-360. The natural image size remains 720 by 720.

settings.name: Theme accent token
settings.description: CSS custom-property name beginning with --. Themes the card border, never QR modules. Neutral fallback if absent.

settings.name: Use a host trigger
settings.description: Suppress the default trigger only when the host supplies one using the public adapter.
